reviews.title: AS2 remote SharedObject WebSocket relay, offline persistence and FMS boundary
reviews.summary: Cross-origin AS2 clients synchronize SharedObject rooms through the neoflash-sync WebSocket relay, restore string-keyed local AMF caches offline and reconcile field-level conflicts on reconnect. Native Adobe RTMP/FMS endpoints remain outside the WebSocket profile.

entries.note: Temporary, server-only and client/server-persistent WebSocket rooms work. A local cache path restores the remote object offline. The native Adobe RTMP/FMS endpoint is unsupported.
The relay restores the authoritative snapshot and reconciles offline changes across publications, including conflict notifications. Native Adobe RTMP/FMS connections are unsupported.
